scope: Only explicitly requested R3 west-lakeside and R8/R10 mountain corridor stations. No whole-world or replacement-owner generation.
game_design_assumptions: R3/R8/R10 are explicitly treated as two-way left-hand-traffic game roads; bidirectional layout data alone does not establish real-world traffic law.
White 0.15 m edge guidance and 3 m / 5 m white center dashes are visual game-design choices, not certification to Japanese road-marking regulations.
Center guidance is permitted only for explicitly approved two-way roads at least 6 m wide. Curvature does not authorize a yellow line, solid centerline, or no-overtaking restriction.

Actual baked junction and platform surfaces and actual other-road carriageways interrupt all paint with a 0.75 m design clearance. Broad vegetation/exclusion circles are not treated as road platforms.
No stop/yield lines, STOP/止まれ text, directional/U-turn arrows, pedestrian crossings, speed restrictions, or priority claims without separate semantic authorization.
Paint is visual only: no collision, no tire_mark_surface group, no grip, traffic, navigation or road-network changes.
